title: Accurate Judges, Useful Teachers
subtitle: Generative reward models · Rollout consistency · Reading Mamba
intro: Two close readings separate static judging accuracy, online learning outcomes, and implementation mismatch; seven briefs cover compute, data, and models from the overlap window. The classic is Mamba: choosing what to write and computing it in parallel.

articles.paper: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
articles.title: Muon, μP, and data scheduling in a 320B MoE recipe
articles.evidence: Read abstract and pretraining overview; not all evaluations audited

blocks.text: 320B total / 15B active parameters; pretraining combines Stable SplitNorm, Muon, and μP, increasing the coding mixture later. The report emphasizes a margin between safe and optimal learning rates; it does not isolate Muon’s causal contribution.[3]

articles.paper: Cola2: Co-Adaptive Hierarchical Language Modeling with Continuous Semantic Compression and Balanced Discrete Generation
articles.authors: Hongcan Guo · Yian Zhao · Feng Wang · Shen Nie · Guoqiang Wei · Yan Zeng · Hengshuang Zhao
articles.title: Joint scaling of continuous semantics and discrete generation

blocks.text: Dynamic semantic segmentation lets token prediction update the encoder while stop-gradient decouples the flow prior. Experiments at about 210B tokens examine design and scaling; an unconverged model with 346.03B source tokens averages 60.10 over eight tasks. Cross-model token differences do not establish a compute-matched advantage.[4]

articles.paper: Learning Robot Behavior Priors from Non-Robotic Synthetic Data
articles.title: Data sources: control priors without robot trajectories

blocks.text: Three procedural control abstractions train a Transformer with nontrivial zero-shot action prediction on unseen robot tasks. A compute-matched real-data baseline is stronger only on its training datasets. This compares data sources and transfer, not a universal robot scaling law.[5]

articles.paper: AQL-Lite: Enabling Efficient Knowledge Acquisition for Arabic LLMs via Data-Centric Continual Pretraining
articles.authors: Houssam Eddine Boukhalfa · Mourad Bouache · Mourad Dahmane
articles.title: Data quality and trainable parameters at fixed token budgets

blocks.text: At a matched 1B tokens, curated data improves the four-task mean by 3.51 points over raw web. At 5B tokens, partial-parameter training recovers 94% of full-CPT gain in 52% of wall time; means are 73.19 vs 73.58. Recovery is the incremental gain over base, not retention of 94% of all capabilities.[6]

articles.paper: Learning from Next-Frame Prediction: Towards Unified and Scalable Visual Representation Learning
articles.title: VANE: next-frame prediction in a fixed semantic space

blocks.text: With a frozen semantic tokenizer, a causal encoder predicts the next full-frame embedding and an auxiliary decoder preserves detail. The paper reports model/data scaling and a 7.1-point gain over V-JEPA 2.1 in EPIC-KITCHENS-100 anticipation mean-class recall@5; strict budget matching is not specified in the abstract.[7]

articles.paper: AirPlayground: Benchmarking Aerial Navigation across Diverse Reconstructed Environments
articles.title: Scene coverage and data scaling for closed-loop navigation

blocks.text: 94 reconstructed scenes, 94K demonstrations, and 46.5M observation-state-action samples. Scaling ACT training from 5 to 70 scenes raises seen/unseen median success from 30.6% to 41.2% and 16.8% to 29.4%. Offline prediction error is not interchangeable with closed-loop success.[8]

blocks.text: S4 (2022) compresses history with a fixed linear system; linear attention (2020) accumulates a finite state. Which language tokens deserve memory depends on content. Mamba (2024) makes writing, reading, and forgetting input-dependent.[10]

blocks.text: A small gate retains state and ignores the current input; a large gate resets toward it. This scalar interpretation is not a convergence theorem for the full network. Input-dependent coefficients break fixed convolution but preserve associativity of affine composition.[10]

blocks.text: A parallel prefix scan is therefore possible. The implementation fuses discretization and recurrence in SRAM and recomputes states in backward, avoiding the full B×L×D×N state tensor in HBM. Selection and hardware-aware execution jointly support linear sequence complexity.[10]

blocks.title: Evidence boundary
blocks.text: Read §2, §§3.1–3.5, Theorem 1, and the selective-copy/induction setups in §4.1. Finite state remains an information bottleneck; linear complexity does not establish equivalence to attention on every retrieval task. Question: at fixed state dimension, can we characterize how much information content selection can retain?[10,11]
